|strategy=By [mailto:vanfleet@bucknell.edu Jim Van Fleet]<ref name="decipher-strategy">https://web.archive.org/web/20040811123219/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/endor/light/small/daughterofskywalker.html</ref>

This card is arguably the best version of [[Leia Organa{{!}}Leia]] so far. Ability 5 means she can easily use most lightsabers, and draw battle destiny to go along with her 4 power. Immunity to attrition &lt;4 means she'll hang around at the end of a battle. [[Leia Organa{{!}}Leia]] finally has numbers like a Jedi. Warrior, pilot, scout and leader adds amazing versatility. In [[Endor (location){{!}}Endor]] booster draft play she's very hard to beat, and a best friend to all your Ewoks! We are already seeing Daughter of [[Luke Skywalker{{!}}Skywalker]] in tournament play, replacing [[Luke Skywalker{{!}}Luke]] on [[Dagobah (location){{!}}Dagobah]] and completing Jedi Tests. She even shares Yodas ability to add a Light side Force icon (at exterior sites) for extra Force generation (and +1 power and forfeit for your Ewoks). Daughter of [[Luke Skywalker{{!}}Skywalker]] also looks good in foil.

Combos: - holds down a Force drain of 4. DoS Minding What She Has Learned, and hauling [[Yoda]] around with [[Luke's Backpack]]; she finishes Jedi Tests easily, and makes a great mental picture.

* [[Daughter Of Skywalker]] + [[Warrior's Courage]] Add two battle destinies if [[Leia Organa{{!}}Leia]] is defending a battle alone at a site.
